title: Drug-Drug Interaction (DDI) Calculator
summary: The DDI Calculator within the Drug Interaction Database (DIDB) is a tool designed to quantitatively assess clinical DDI risk of a compound acting as a precipitant or perpetrator based on the compound properties and early in vitro results.

### Assess drug interactions and safety with industry’s largest scientist-curated database


Drug interaction database (DIDB®) advances drug interaction science with features including:


- DIDB Queries: Up-to-date access to 28,500+ literature citations, 700+ NDAs and BLAs, and 1,000+ comprehensive DDI summaries
- Concomitant Meds Navigator: Streamline identification of relevant concomitant medications for clinical trials, drug labeling, and development strategies
- DDI Calculator: Quickly calculate clinical DDI risk


[Learn more about DIDB](https://www.certara.com/drug-interaction-database-didb/)
